entities.name: Simón Díaz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Simón Narciso Díaz Márquez, also known as tío Simón, was a Venezuelan singer, actor, TV host, comedian, and Grammy Award-winning composer of Venezuelan music. Some of his most popular songs include Caballo viejo, Tonada de luna llena and La vaca Mariposa.
